title: Limitmc randomkits
description: A plugin from play.limitmc.net where if you die you get a random kit...
body:
# Randomkits plugin
This is a plugin for servers that wants a randomkit system. If you die you get a randomkit that you made

**Check the plugin out on: Play.limitmc.net and then join the randomkits server**

# Commands

1: First make a inventory/kit that you want to have
2: /rkits create (name)
3: Click on the chest to Copy the inventory
4: Run: /Rkits settings (kit name)
Choose what you want like: You need a permission to get this kit (good for paid ranks)
Set the chance you get the kit
Or set the icon for /Rkits list
5: Now if you die you get a randomkit that you made

You can run /rkits forcekit (player) (kit) to get the kit.
If you name a kit daily you can get it with: /rkits dailykit and you can make a skript that
It gives you the kit if you run /daily

It supports all the item id the item has so custom textures items supported.
